item.title: Tuckahoe boots Greenwich football from the Class D state playoffs on final play
item.description: Greenwich coach Brandon Linnett's team saw its season come to an end Friday with a state semifinal loss to Tuckahoe. (Jim Franco/Times Union) MIDDLETOWN - Being in a tight state semifinal game at Middletown High School isn't a new experience for the Greenwich football team. Friday, the Witches found themselves in another tight tussle against Section 1 champion Tuckahoe. The game was tied late and the Tigers displayed a flair for the dramatic, first completing a 22-yard pass down to the Greenwich 10-yard line with four seconds remaining. From there, sophomore kicker Zander Gjeloshaj - who caught the pass to get the Tigers into field goal range - booted a 27-yard field goal as time expired as Tuckahoe registered a thrilling 17-14 victory over the Witches in the Class D state semifinals. "They made some nice plays down the stretch," Greenwich coach Brandon Linnett said. "They had a real good second half. We probably needed to be more than 6-0 at halftime. We dominated. Their defense dominated in the second half." Tuckahoe (8-3), ranked No. 2 in the state, did not score until the fourth quarter and still trailed 14-7 until 6-foot-5 junior tight end Luca DelConte caught a pass along the left sideline, stiff-armed a defender and proceeded to dash for a 64-yard touchdown. The Tigers added the extra-point boot to tie it with 3:55 left. On its ensuing possession, Greenwich reached the Tuckahoe 26-yard line and was stopped on downs with 1:23 left. The Tigers quickly drove down the field and converted a fourth-down pass to Gjeloshaj to set the stage for his game-winning field goal. "It just didn't go our way in the second half," said Greenwich junior Ethan Saunders, who shifted from wingback to quarterback following an injury suffered last week by sophomore quarterback Brett Traver. "It was a crazy game right down to the wire," Friday's result was the Witches' third consecutive painful conclusion at this stage of the state playoffs. Greenwich also fell to Tuckahoe 13-7 in last year's semifinals and dropped a 25-18 decision against Burke Catholic in the 2024 semifinals. "I am a little disappointed for my kids. Seniors, it is tough. It is always tough to say goodbye," Linnett said. "I understand what we have accomplished here. In a couple of days, they will, too." The Witches grabbed a 14-7 lead on a 3-yard Saunders touchdown run with 8:02 remaining. "Not having Brett was a big deal, but Ethan did a great job at quarterback. He made some big throws, and his legs were huge," Linnett said. "We adjusted what we had to do during the week and our kids adjusted well." Key moment The only reception of the game made by Gjeloshaj saw the sophomore catch the ball at around the 18 and work his way forward eight more yards. Justin Gjekaj, Tuckahoe's holder, snared a high snap and Gjeloshaj calmly pounded the ball through the uprights to end the game. item.title: Browns’ Delpit Couldn’t Help Himself From Trolling The Steelers
item.description: Grant Delpit has no chill. The Cleveland Browns defensive back talked to reporters on Friday, and before he finished his media session, he seemingly took a shot at the drama surrounding the Pittsburgh Steelers , one of Cleveland’s AFC North rivals. Delpit, who’s played his entire NFL career so far in Cleveland uniform, ended his talk with reporters with a “1, 2, 3 Browns” statement. Here is that moment as seen in a clip shared by Daryl Ruiter of 92.3 The Fan: Grant Delpit with a “1-2-3 #Browns ” walk off. pic.twitter.com/Ml2eLd0viw — Daryl Ruiter (@RuiterWrongFAN) November 27, 2026 Browns’ Delpit Couldn’t Help Himself From Trolling The Steelers Rodgers (8) throws a pass during the fourth quarter of an NFL game against Cleveland at Acrisure Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Barry Reeger-Imagn Images On its own, that quote doesn’t seem anything remotely beyond normal. But given the wild drama that unfolded this week concerning Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers, it’s not hard to interpret Delpit’s words as a subtle (and hilarious) shot at Pittsburgh. When Rodgers decided to talk and appear on “The Pat McAfee Show” on Wednesday after Pittsburgh benched him, one of his head-turning comments was a story about Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy mistakenly saying “1, 2, 3 Packers” during a Pittsburgh huddle. Delpit is hardly the only one who’s made light of the fallout of Rodgers’ exit from the Steelers, but him being a Brown surely adds some flavor to his joke. Cleveland is coming off a Week 11 bye, so Delpit might also have some extra energy to keep up with the news around the league. However, his real focus is on the Browns’ intriguing matchup against Fernando Mendoza and the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday. item.title: Aztecs can’t overcome slow start, rough shooting afternoon in loss at Hawaii
item.description: San Diego State junior forward Bailey Barnhard (20) dribbles against Hawaii junior forward Zyriah Price on Friday, November 27, 2026 at the Rainbow Wahine Showdown at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center in Honolulu, Hawaii. Trailing by 7 points inside the final minute, the San Diego State Aztecs missed three consecutive 3-pointer attempts on a possession, which typified a frustrating afternoon in a 71-64 loss to the Hawaii Rainbow Wahine on Friday at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center. Junior forward Bailey Barnhard scored 17 points with 12 rebounds, her first career double-double, but SDSU (4-3) missed their first seven shots as Hawaii (2-5) opened with a 12-0 lead they never relinquished. Sophomore guard Bailey Flavell scored a career-high 28 points alongside 6 rebounds and 5 assists for the Rainbow Wahine, and junior center Ritoya Tamilo added 17 points and 6 rebounds. “(Hawaii) made some shots that we weren’t ready for. (Flavell) got hot and we couldn’t really do anything to slow her down, so giving up 28 points to a player, we knew we were going to have our hands full with (Tamilo’s) height…hats off to them, they beat us from the jump,” head coach Stacie Terry-Hutson said. In their second road game of the season, the Aztecs shot under 40% from the field in three of the four quarters, including a frigid fourth which saw the side make just 4-of-19 from the field. Senior guard Eva DeChent, who finished with 12 points before fouling out, and freshman forward Mayenabasi Akpan were the only players other than Barnhard to make a bucket in the final frame. Akpan played 6 of her 13 minutes in the fourth, putting up a tidy 7 points and 3 rebounds in her brief bits of action for the game. Despite falling down by a dozen out of the game, the Aztecs were able to battle back to even in the first quarter with 30 seconds remaining thanks to an 8-0 push. A Barnhard free-throw split and buckets from junior guard Alayna Kraus and junior guard Natalia Martinez, who splashed her first of three 3’s in the game and added a jumper, squared the score, but Flavell tripled to give Hawaii the lead after one quarter. “I thought we battled them pretty evenly if you look at the score in the quarters, we gave ourselves a really big mountain to climb out of…but I thought we tried to battle. We played hard, I thought we showed some toughness,” Terry-Hutson said. The Rainbow Wahine came into the game averaging 3.8 3-pointers per game and hit eight from beyond the arc, with four coming in the second quarter. Senior guard Jovi Lefotu made a pair from beyond in the first 3:05 that gave Hawaii a multi-possession lead. But depth charges from Kraus, fifth-year forward Kennedy Lee and junior guard Nayli Padilla had SDSU trailing by just four at 33-29 come halftime. Those 3-pointers were needed, as the Aztecs did not get a paint bucket until Barnhard’s layup just over half way through the third quarter. item.title: Carson Beck to Sit Out Another Cardinals Game Amid Back Issue
item.description: The Arizona Cardinals will continue to roll with Josh Johnson under center when they see action on Sunday against the Washington Commanders at State Farm Stadium in Glendale. The Cards have once again ruled out rookie quarterback Carson Beck, as he continues to deal with a back issue. “Mike LaFleur officially rules out QB Carson Beck for Sunday’s game. Not a surprise. Josh Johnson gets a second start for the Cardinals,” team reporter Darren Urban shared via a social media post on X. This development on Beck isn’t surprising, given that he had not practiced from Wednesday to Thursday. Beck to Sit Out Another Cardinals Game Amid Back Issue Nov 15, 2026; Glendale, Arizona, USA; Arizona Cardinals quarterback Carson Beck (19) warms up before the game against the Los Angeles Rams at State Farm Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Matt Kartozian-Imagn Images The former Miami Hurricanes star signal-caller made his first-ever start in a Week 10 matchup against the Los Angeles Rams but sat out the next one, a game versus Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 11 . Both games resulted in lopsided losses for Arizona, with the Rams beating the Cards, 34-6, and the Chiefs handing them a 34-7 beatdown. Arizona seems shaky at best with Johnson starting at quarterback, but the same can be said about the team with Beck, who still has a lot to prove in the league. Beck passed for just 108 yards with zero touchdowns and two interceptions on 11/18 pass completions in the Rams game. Johnson, on the other hand, went 18/31 for 155 passing yards and a touchdown with zero interceptions in the loss to the Chiefs. The Cards will enter the matchup against the Commanders with a 3-8 record and on a three-game losing streak. item.title: Al Michaels Has a Hilarious Reaction to the Steelers-Broncos Scorigami
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers scored a statement win on Friday, putting a drama-filled week amid Aaron Rodgers’ sudden exit behind them with a 27-5 victory over the Denver Broncos at Acrisure Stadium in Week 12. If the final score of that game sounded odd, it’s because it was the first time in the history of the NFL that a game ended 27-5. Pittsburgh’s defense stepped up in a big way for the team, with TJ Watt scoring a touchdown after recovering a fumble by Denver quarterback in the end zone, while Jalen Ramsey took one to the house after intercepting Nix. Making his first start after the Steelers released Rodgers , Mason Rudolph went 9/15 for 142 passing yards and a touchdown with zero interceptions. Meanwhile, Rico Dowdle rushed 11 times for 71 yards. Nix had a rough outing a day after Thanksgiving, going 22/40 for 169 passing yards with no touchdowns and two picks, while getting sacked three times for a loss of 37 yards. Al Michaels Has a Hilarious Reaction to the Steelers-Broncos Scorigami Oct 1, 2026; Cleveland, Ohio, USA; Pittsburgh linebacker T.J. Watt (90) reacts in the second half at Huntington Bank Field. Mandatory Credit: Scott Galvin-Imagn Images As Kirk Herbstreit was mentioning in the Amazon Prime broadcast the fact that the final score of the game was a scorigami, Al Michaels dropped a head-turning quip, saying, “Oh, I knew that. I had that. On Kalshi.” Here is a clip of that conversation between Herbstreit and Michaels as the broadcast showed McCarthy walking off the field following the Steelers’ victory. https://twitter.com/awfulannouncing/status/2126464521212424306 While it’s a big win for Pittsburgh, Denver wasted a great opportunity to create a little more separation between them and the Kansas City Chiefs in the AFC West Division standings. The Chiefs dropped to 8-3 after losing to the Buffalo Bills in a Thanksgiving Day game on Thursday, and they still share the same record with the AFC West-leading Broncos after Denver’s defeat on Friday. item.title: Steelers cap tumultuous week with 27-5 rout of Broncos
item.description: Pittsburgh's Jalen Ramsey returns an interception for a touchdown in the Steelers' NFL win over the Denver Broncos (Justin K. Aller) The Pittsburgh Steelers shook off the controversy sparked by star quarterback Aaron Rodgers's bitter midweek departure to dominate the Denver Broncos 27-5 in a key NFL clash on Friday. Mason Rudolph stepped in at quarterback and threw for 142 yards and one touchdown to wide receiver DK Metcalf, and the Steelers' defense scored two touchdowns as Pittsburgh ended the Broncos' six-game winning streak. Steelers linebacker T.J. Watt recovered a fumble by Broncos quarterback Bo Nix in the end zone for the Steelers' opening touchdown, and Jalen Ramsey ran a Nix interception back for a TD, Pittsburgh's defense harrying Nix into a series of uncharacteristic mistakes in difficult, rainy conditions. The Steelers remained unbeaten at home, improving to 7-4 as they at least temporarily put the ugly split from four-time NFL Most Valuable Player Rodgers aside. Rodgers, a Super Bowl champion who turns 43 next week, had been benched for the game amid a rift with Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy over the coach's offensive play calling. Rodgers then went on ESPN's "The Pat McAfee Show" and aired an array of complaints about the coach, alleging McCarthy had fallen asleep in team meetings and suggesting he wasn't fit for the job. Steelers owner Art Rooney II voiced support for McCarthy on Thursday, saying that "insubordination can't be tolerated in any organization." McCarthy and Steelers players had been tight-lipped in their responses in the days before the game, although Metcalf flashed eight fingers in a touchdown celebration interpreted as a reference to Rodgers's number eight. "At the end of the day, it's football, and we have a job to do as professionals to go out there and compete at the highest level and win games," said tight end Pat Freiermuth. "Regardless of the noise, it's our responsibility and our job to block out the noise." Rudolph said he appreciated the support he'd received from teammates after they were all rocked by the week's events. "They all had the same mixed emotions that I did, just shocked at what on earth just happened when you wake up on Wednesday morning," Rudolph said. "After the initial shocks sort of passed through, they just made it known that they were with me, behind me. It wasn't like a throw in the towel, season's over vibe." It was a damaging defeat for Denver, which fell to 8-3 to slip further behind the 10-1 Buffalo Bills in the race for the top seed in the AFC. They are tied with the Kansas City Chiefs atop the AFC West division. McCarthy called it a "special win" after back-to-back defeats that had helped ramp up the tensions within the team. "You look at what's happened the last two weeks, we needed a win. We needed a win, and it was old-fashioned. It was black and blue, downhill, just going after it, staying square, fundamental football." bb/des

item.title: Postgame Reaction: Avalanche Rally From Three-Goal Deficit to Beat Wild in Shootout
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect What an incredible comeback. The Colorado Avalanche, without Nathan MacKinnon or Martin Necas , erased a three-goal deficit in the final 6:23 of regulation before beating the Minnesota Wild 4-3 in a shootout Friday at Grand Casino Arena. Trailing 3-0 late in the third period, Colorado mounted an improbable comeback to steal two points from the top team in the Central Division. Devon Toews , Artturi Lehkonen , and T.J. Hughes scored to even the game before the end of regulation. Hughes and Lehkonen also added assists. Mackenzie Blackwood made 19 saves, including a relatively quiet third period in which he faced just two shots. He didn’t see a single shot in overtime. Cale Makar provided the lone shootout goal among eight total attempts. It’s arguably the most impressive win of the season for the Avalanche, particularly given the circumstances. Following Wednesday’s victory over the Montreal Canadiens, Taylor Makar was called up to join the team on its road trip. Then, right before puck drop Friday, the Avalanche announced that Necas would miss the game with an upper-body injury . Hughes was promoted to the top line, while the younger Makar slotted into the third line. The Wild, meanwhile, were without Quinn Hughes and looking to rebound from their first regulation loss since Oct. 22. Their 12-0-3 stretch came to an end against the Utah Mammoth. Colorado dug itself an early hole in the first period, with two goals that were largely self-inflicted. First, Joel Eriksson Ek opened the scoring with an impressive individual effort after an Avalanche turnover at their own blue line. Blake Coleman then doubled the lead with a solo effort of his own, beating Blackwood on a shot the Colorado netminder would probably like to have back. The Avalanche didn’t have much going for them in the opening period, and that continued into the second. Their best opportunity came on a Hughes breakaway, but Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt came up with the stop. Eriksson Ek added his second of the night later in the period, sending Minnesota into the third with a comfortable 3-0 lead. Even with Colorado outshooting Minnesota early, it was difficult to envision the Avalanche having this kind of comeback in them. Head coach Jared Bednar pulled Blackwood with more than seven minutes remaining, shortly after Parker Kelly and Kirill Kaprizov were assessed matching minors. The resulting power play gave Colorado a 5-on-4 advantage, and Toews made it count. The defenseman scored his 10th goal of the season with just over six minutes remaining to get the comeback started. Colorado pulled Blackwood again, and Minnesota nearly put the game away with an empty-net goal. But Makar came up with a terrific defensive play to prevent it. The Avalanche quickly went the other way, and Makar’s point shot was redirected by Lehkonen to make it 3-2. The goal, Lehkonen’s 17th of the season, came with 3:59 remaining. item.title: Florida Football Delivers Crushing Blow to Florida State as Rivalry Loss Comes With Major Consequences
item.description: Florida Gators head coach Jon Sumrall watches his players from the sidelines. The Florida Gators lead the Florida State Seminoles at the half 10-3 on Friday, Nov. 27, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida delivered more than another rivalry victory Friday afternoon. The Gators also brought Florida State’s season to a painful conclusion. No. 20 Florida defeated Florida State 26-10 at Doak Campbell Stadium, securing its third consecutive victory over the Seminoles. However, the result carried much greater consequences for the home team. Florida State entered the Sunshine State rivalry needing one victory to qualify for a bowl game. Instead, the Seminoles will miss the postseason for the third consecutive season. Meanwhile, Florida celebrated a historic individual milestone and an impressive finish to its first regular season under coach Jon Sumrall. Florida Ends Florida State’s Bowl Hopes The Seminoles entered Friday with a 5-6 record and an opportunity to salvage their season. However, Florida’s defense made that task increasingly difficult. The Gators recorded six sacks, forced seven punts and intercepted Florida State quarterback Ashton Daniels twice. Both interceptions came from defensive back J’Vari Flowers. Florida State struggled to sustain drives, converting just five of its 17 third-down opportunities. The Seminoles also went 1-for-4 on fourth down. Although Florida State finished with more total yards than Florida, the Gators consistently made the plays that mattered most. Consequently, the Seminoles finished their season at 5-7. The result marked Florida State’s third consecutive season without a bowl appearance, extending a frustrating stretch for one of college football’s most recognizable programs. Jadan Baugh Makes Florida History Against Seminoles Florida running back Jadan Baugh entered Friday needing just 20 rushing yards to accomplish a historic milestone. He finished with 77 yards on 19 carries and a touchdown. More importantly, Baugh became the first Florida running back to record consecutive 1,000-yard regular seasons under the program’s official statistical records. The achievement added another chapter to his impressive history against Florida State. Last season, Baugh rushed for 266 yards in Florida’s 40-21 victory over the Seminoles. That performance ranked among the greatest single-game rushing efforts in Florida history. Now, Baugh has another memorable accomplishment against his team’s biggest in-state rival. His 3-yard touchdown run in the first quarter gave Florida an early 7-0 lead. The Gators never trailed. Florida Overcomes Quarterback Injury Florida also faced an unexpected challenge during the second half. Starting quarterback Aaron Philo exited with an apparent injury during the Gators’ opening possession of the third quarter. Philo completed nine of 12 passes for 127 yards before leaving the game. item.title: WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at 38 After ‘Medical Complications’
item.description: Jermaine Haley, a.k.a. Bronson Reed Credit: WWE NEED TO KNOW WWE star Bronson Reed died at age 38 The athlete was known outside the ring as Jermaine Haley In a statement, the WWE said he died due to “medical complications” WWE star Bronson Reed, known outside the ring as Jermaine Haley, has died at age 38. The news was shared in a statement from the WWE on Instagram Friday, Nov. 27. “WWE is devastated to announce that Jermaine Haley, also known as Bronson Reed, passed away earlier today at the age of 38 due to medical complications,” the statement read. The organization described Haley, who made his television debut in 2019, as a “larger-than-life figure.” View this post on Instagram “Jermaine was a larger-than-life figure in WWE, but more importantly, he was a phenomenal person, a devoted family man, and a beloved colleague,” the statement added. The company concluded the statement by sharing condolences to Haley’s loved ones, including his pregnant wife Paige. “Our thoughts and deepest condolences are with Jermaine’s entire family, including his pregnant wife, Paige, their daughter, as well as his friends, co-workers and fans,” the statement concluded. The Australian athlete had reportedly sustained injuries during the Crown Jewel event held in Saudi Arabia earlier this month on Nov. 7. Many supporters of Haley paid tribute to him in the comment section of the WWE’s post. “Damn, Bronson Reed was one of the best heels we had in WWE in a long time. RIP Big Man,” wrote one user. Another fan said, “Absolutely devastating is an understatement. Such a kind hearted human being....” WWE star Angel Garza commented with broken-heart emojis, “💔💔💔💔💔.” Pro wrestler Sammy Guevara also wrote, “Truly devastating 💔 Sending nothing but love and strength to his entire family!” Read the original article on People

item.title: John Harbaugh’s wife perfectly sums up NFL Thanksgiving Day drama
item.description: Head coach John Harbaugh of the New York Giants is all smiles during the second half at MetLife Stadium, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026, in Brooklyn, NY. John Harbaugh could run for mayor of what his wife calls “Crazy Town.” Harbaugh will coach for his 200th career victory (regular season plus playoffs) Sunday against the Colts in Indianapolis. He ranks third among active coaches behind mentor Andy Reid (315) and Sean Payton (202), though only the last six wins are with the Giants. Access the Giants like never before Get texts from Paul Schwartz with all the latest Giants news and insights, exclusive to Sports+ subscribers. tRY IT NOW “The wins are really hard to get,” Harbaugh said. “They’re really valuable. … There’s no greater football joy than that winning locker room. I would just say every one of those wins is the same. It’s like my dad says, ‘You’ve never had a better win than this one.’ Every [win] feels that way. The next one is really hard to get.” Ingrid Harbaugh started referring to the NFL as “Crazy Town” this year because of all the games decided by twists and turns in the final minutes. The three Thanksgiving Day games all featured game-winning scores in the final three seconds. The Eagles’ 21-point comeback against the Cowboys had the biggest impact on the NFC East-leading Giants — and serves as a great example of “Crazy Town.” New York Giants head coach John Harbaugh speaks at a press conference when the New York Giants practiced Wednesday, November 25, 2026 at Quest Diagnostics Training Center in East Rutherford, NJ. Robert Sabo for NY Post “Oh, my gosh, was it ever,” Harbaugh said. “It just goes to show you that these games are going to come down to the fourth quarter. You give the Eagles a lot of credit for the game they played. All six of those teams are fighting in the fourth quarter for the win. “Kind of goes to the other point … how hard it is to win these games. And, if you can, become a team that finds ways to win games and can keep their poise and make plays. Hopefully, you scheme some good plays up, too, to win games at the end. That’s the way they go. You have to be expecting that, I think — not be surprised by it.” Head coach John Harbaugh of the New York Giants is all smiles during the second half at MetLife Stadium, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026, in Brooklyn, NY. Corey Sipkin for NY Post DT Shelby Harris (illness) will not play after not practicing for the third straight day. The Giants will ask more of Darius Alexander, C.J. Okoye and Bobby Jamison-Travis next to D.J. Reader. CB Dru Phillips (illness) and OLB Abdul Carter (calf/illness) were limited participants but are expected to play. item.title: Steelers’ Cam Heyward gives Mason Rudolph props for stepping up vs. Broncos
item.description: Charles LeClaire-Imagn Images Steelers’ Cam Heyward gives Mason Rudolph props for stepping up vs. Broncos appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . As the Pittsburgh Steelers (7-4) earned a 27-5 victory over the Denver Broncos (8-3), as if the Aaron Rodgers drama never happened, quarterback Mason Rudolph stepped up and delivered a poised performance. While the Steelers had very little problems beating the Broncos on Friday to many people’s surprise, veteran defensive star Cameron Heyward doesn’t share that feeling. It was an emotional week for the football team as Rodgers was benched earlier in the week, as a Wednesday appearance by the veteran signal-caller on “The Pat McAfee Show” had him calling out head coach Mike McCarthy for an abundance of incriminating events. Whether it be sleeping during team meetings or mistaking the team he’s coaching for the Green Bay Packers during a halftime huddle in the 19-16 loss to the Philadelphia Eagles last Sunday, Rodgers had enough. Rodgers gave McCarthy an ultimatum to relinquish play-calling duties to himself or someone else, or the team should just release him. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Less than an hour after the appearance, Rodgers was cut, though Rudolph was announced to be the starter even before. Against the Broncos, Rudolph threw for 142 yards while completing nine of 15 pass attempts with a touchdown. Managing the game well and keeping the lead after two defensive touchdowns, Heyward would express how Rudolph “delivers” in a “poised” manner. “Oh, he’s ready for it,” Heyward said, via NFL on Prime Video. “You know, it’s crazy, we act like Steelers haven’t had drama before. We’ve had plenty of drama, and so Mason has been ready for this moment. Mason’s been put in this spot to deliver, and so when he’s out there, he delivers. It’s nothing new to him, and he plays poised.” "When he's out there, he delivers." Cam Heyward knew Mason Rudolph was ready to step up on #BlackFridayNFL pic.twitter.com/GNSeV7tfkE — NFL on Prime Video (@NFLonPrime) November 27, 2026 Rudolph and the Steelers look to keep the momentum going on Dec. 6 against the Houston Texans (4-6). item.title: Atlético face Cruzeiro in Mineiro Under-15 title decider
item.description: Atlético face Cruzeiro in Mineiro Under-15 title decider Atlético take to the field this Saturday (28/11) at 8:30 a.m. to face Cruzeiro in the second leg of the Campeonato Mineiro Under-15 final . The title decider will be played at Sesc Venda Nova in Belo Horizonte, with live coverage on GaloTV . Unbeaten in the competition, the Galo youngsters will look to protect their first-leg lead and claim the state title. Watch the match live: First-leg advantage and a perfect derby record Moisés celebrates Galo's fourth goal in the 4–1 rout of their rivals. Photo: Arthur Henrique / Atlético In the first leg of the final, played on November 21 at Toca da Raposa I, Galo Under-15s thrashed Cruzeiro 4–1 , with goals from Mauro Júnior , Kaio Ferreira and Moisés Caetano , plus an own goal. The result means coach Rômulo Rodriguez 's side can lose by up to two goals this Saturday and still lift the trophy. The first-leg victory maintained Atlético's derby dominance in 2026. During the state championship, Atlético and Cruzeiro have met three times, with Galo winning all three , scoring ten goals and conceding just one: First Stage (18/07): Atlético 5–0 Cruzeiro – Cidade do Galo Final Eight Stage (26/09): Cruzeiro 0–1 Atlético – Toca da Raposa I Final – First Leg (21/11): Cruzeiro 1–4 Atlético – Toca da Raposa I An unbeaten campaign and dominance in 2026 Enzo Rodrigues in the second meeting between Atlético and Cruzeiro in the 2026 state championship. Photo: Arthur Henrique / Atlético Atlético head into the Campeonato Mineiro Under-15 final unbeaten , with 21 wins and three draws in 24 matches — taking 91.7% of the available points. Their attack has found the net 74 times (averaging more than three goals per game), while the defense has conceded just eight goals throughout the tournament. In the semifinals, the team eliminated North 10–0 on aggregate (6–0 in Montes Claros and 4–0 in Belo Horizonte). item.title: Recap: Colorado erases 3-0 deficet; beats Minnesota in a shootout
item.description: SAINT PAUL, MN - NOVEMBER 27: Cale Makar #8 of the Colorado Avalanche skates with the puck while Joel Eriksson Ek #14 of the Minnesota Wild defends during the game at Grand Casino Arena on November 27, 2026 in Saint Paul, Minnesota. (Photo by Matt Krohn/NHLI via Getty Images) | NHLI via Getty Images After securing a 6-0 win over the Montreal Canadiens on Wednesday night, the Colorado Avalanche kicked off a back-to-back tonight with a game against the Minnesota Wild. While the Wild found themselves up 3-0 after the second period, the Avs were able to completely erase that deficet in the third period, and ultimately secured a win in the shootout by a final score of 4-3. Let’s take a look at how it all happened! First Period Joel Eriksson Ek would open the scoring for the Wild, as he was able to split through the Colorado defense and put a wrist shot on net that beat Mackenzie Blackwood up high. Blake Coleman made it 2-0 next by driving in towards the Colorado net all the way from Minnesota’s own zone, and was able to sneak the puck past Blackwood. Second Period Eriksson Ek scored his second goal of the game with less than a minute left in the second period off a great feed for Brock Faber, who found Eriksson Ek down low driving towards the Colorado net. Third Period With the net empty and just over six minutes to play in regulation, Devon Toews finally got Colorado on the scoreboard, as he was able to rip the puck across his body and past Jesper Wallstedt. Artturi Lehkonen would score his 17th goal of the season to bring the Avs within one, off a shot from Cale Makar that he was able to tip past Wallstedt. T.J. Hughes would be the one to tie the game up at 3-3 with less than a minute left in regulation. Makar again took a shot from the top of the zone, which did not get fully through to the net, but Minnesota was unable to find the puck, Hughes found the rebound, and scored on a bar-down slapshot to tie this game and send it to overtime and the eventual shootout. Overtime & Shootout Both teams had some good looks in overtime, but were not able to convert obviously, and we would eventually head to a shootout. Makar was the fourth shooter for the Avalanche, and he would be the one to ultimately beat Wallstedt in the shootout, as he was able to sneak the puck past the Wild goaltender, and secure the 4-3 win. Takeaways After absolutely taking care of business against Montreal a couple of nights ago, for a very wide majority of this game, it definitely looked like the same outcome was not to be had. Minnesota was kind of having their way with the Avs through the first and second periods of this game, but their inability to put the game away with under 10 minutes left in regulation gave the Avs the opportunity to pull the goalie and attempt to tie the game, which they were able to do, of course. During the shootout, Minnesota’s players had a handful of good looks, but they were unable to get the shot off, ended up missing the net, or were stopped by Blac

item.title: Masked Ethan Brown shines in Illinois win
item.description: CHAMPAIGN, Ill. — Just four days ago, Illinois freshman guard Ethan Brown broke his nose in multiple different places. Two days ago, he got surgery to repair that broken nose, causing many to speculate that he may take some time off to rest and recover. That would not be the case. Friday night, Brown returned to the Illini starting lineup without skipping a beat, playing a key role in the team’s big win over the Western Kentucky Hilltoppers. First and foremost, it was a remarkable efficient night for the young guard from a scoring standpoint. He finished with 22 points while shooting 8-12 from the field, and 4-7 from downtown. He also stuffed the stat sheet, adding eight rebounds and four assists. Like usual, Brown played beyond his years in terms of making winning plays. In one sequence in the first half, he cleaned up a missed shot from Zavier Zens with an offensive rebound and putback on one possession, then dished out a clean pass to a cutting Zvonimir Ivisic for a transition dunk shortly after. Brown has been instrumental through the team’s first eight games, as he leads Illinois in both assists and rebounds, while also being a double-digit scorer on average.

item.title: Bronson Reed (Jermaine Haley) Shockingly Dies At 38
item.description: Bronson Reed died at 38 WWE WWE Superstar Bronson Reed shockingly died at 38 amid a serious kidney issues that led to undisclosed surgery earlier this month following his cameo at WWE Crown Jewel 12026 . After taking a bump off the stage through multiple tables, Reed remained in Saudi Arabia after suffering multiple broken ribs and a lacerated kidney following a garden-variety Beal toss from rising star Oba Femi. The spot appeared to go as planned, but Reed underwent surgery and recovery following the incident. Bronson Reed was a rising star in WWE, positioned prominently with top heel stable The Vision alongside the deliberate future of WWE in Logan Paul, Austin Theory, Bron Breakker and Paul Heyman, who has churned out countless mentees who became Hall of Famers under his guidance. Reed was known for his fast-paced style despite being a big man, and really excelled when he developed his flying splash finisher otherwise known as the Tsunami. Despite being a basic finisher in the context of 2026 pro wrestling, which is more high-risk than ever, Reed’s theatrical splash was a weekly highlight on WWE programming. The former New Japan Pro Wrestling standout was released by WWE in 2021, an incident which took him by surprise. The former NXT North American champion returned to WWE the following year and went on to reinvent himself as a more svelte big man, dropping over 100 pounds ahead of his 2026 return from injury. After suffering injuries at Crown Jewel, Reed’s surgery was believed to have been a success. “In great news, we are told Bronson Reed has made it back home and is continuing his recovery from surgery. Continued best wishes,” reported Bryan Alvarez of Wrestling Observer Live (h/t WrestleZone .) Reed had previously suffered a fractured talus bone in November 2024 and a torn distal biceps in February 2026. Bronson is survived by his wife, high school sweetheart Paige Haley, and their two children, one of which is on the way. Reed was finally hitting his stride as a legitimate potential main eventer, and similar to fellow international star PAC—who passed away earlier this year—Bronson Reed is gone too soon. FORBES | By Alfred Konuwa Jonah Talks Battle Of Los Angeles 2022, NJPW And Wanting A Match With Keith Lee Bronson Reed Passes Away As The Wrestling World Reacts This article was originally published on Forbes.com

item.title: Michigan basketball finally discovers winning recipe in Vegas vs K-State
item.description: This was sorely needed for Michigan basketball . After getting blown out in their first two games in Las Vegas this week, it was the Wolverines ' turn to drop a beatdown, hammering Kansas State , 98-69, on Friday, Nov. 27 to avoid getting swept in the Players Era 16 tournament. U-M's new big three – Elliot Cadeau, Trey McKenney and Moustapha Thiam – played their best game this season against a Power Four team this season. McKenney scored 18 points and Cadeau also had 18 with eight assists, while Thiam had his first double-double (16 points and 16 rebounds). U-M had three players with at least 15 points for the sixth time this season, tied for the best mark in Division I. OFF THE COURT: Inside Michigan AD debacle, what's next and Kyle Whittingham's future This isn't exactly a marquee win − KSU has lost to South Dakota State and Campbell already this season − but it was important for the Wolverines (4-4) to start getting some mojo back after losing three straight and getting off to the worst start for any defending national champion through seven games since Louisville opened the 1986-87 season at 3-4. It was over when ... The demolition started early as U-M led by 17 at halftime and continued to pour it on in the second half. Michigan was up 15 just 10 minutes in before a 13-2 KSU run cut the game to seven. That's when Mike Boynton Jr.'s team ripped off a 12-0 run of its own, which started with a pocket pass from Cadeau to Thiam for an layup and a foul. Though he missed the free throw, U-M got the offensive board and McKenney drilled a 3. After a pair of J.P. Estrella free throws, Joseph Hartmann hit a slashing floater, Kenny Noland made a free throw and McKenney made a midrange baseline jumper to go up 16. Kansas State never got inside single digits again. Trending up: The bench While Michigan's most consistent player, Estrella, did what he does with 12 points and four rebounds, one key aspect to this game was U-M's production from its reserves. Kenny Noland tied a season-high with 11 while freshman Joseph Hartmann, who returned from a shoulder injury for this tournament, had the best game of his young career with 10 points and freshman Quinn Costello hit three 3s for nine points, as Michigan's bench outscored Kansas State's, 32-22. The Wolverines entered play No. 308 in 3-point shooting (27.8%) and No. 320 in defending 3s (38%) but was much better in that regard, going 13-for-32 (40.6%) while KSU was just 10-for-39 (25.6%). But where Michigan did its best work was down low, topping the Wildcats in rebounding, 46-35; second-chance points, 19-9; and points in the paint, 38-22. Next up: Delta Devils The Wolverines won't have a ton of rest, as they return to Ann Arbor to host Mississippi Valley State on Tuesday (7 p.m., Big Ten Network). The Delta Devils, as is their custom, have had a rough start to the season, losing their first eight games, all on their road. item.title: Kirk Herbstreit compares Aaron Rodgers, Mike McCarthy to his divorced parents
item.description: Credit: Prime Video, USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect NFL media members and Pittsburgh Steelers fans have lived a thousand lives since roughly 11 p.m. Tuesday, when the Steelers shockingly benched Aaron Rodgers, giving Kirk Herbstreit flashbacks to his former life. Rodgers, a four-time NFL MVP quarterback and 42-year-old man, then did what any logical adult would do: Go on The Pat McAfee Show and humiliate the organization . More specifically, Rodgers used his Wednesday appearance with McAfee to air every grievance he’s ever had about Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy, who also coached him for nearly 13 years in Green Bay. Pittsburgh released Rodgers shortly thereafter. Rodgers’ scorched-earth approach drew reactions from across the sports world, including reporting from Tom Pelissero . Former Steelers head coach Mike Tomlin even weighed in . While the melting pot of opinions made Rodgers’ release one of the more fascinating, zeitgeist-y moments in recent NFL history, Mina Kimes’ take hit the nail squarely on the head . “The Steelers organization is the one who deserves the most blame,” Kimes said during her eponymous podcast released Thursday. “The front office and ownership. It was all so goddamn predictable. Everybody was shocked when this reunion happened because we all knew they didn’t like each other.” Kimes added, “There was no market for Rodgers. I’m pretty sure there was no market for Mike McCarthy. So, it felt like a marriage of inconvenience of two people who clearly hated each other.” During Prime Video’s broadcast of the Steelers’ 27-5 win over the Denver Broncos on Friday, Herbstreit took Kimes’ analogy several steps further. At the start of the fourth quarter, legendary play-by-play announcer Al Michaels read aloud from a text Rodgers sent him that read like a veiled shot at Tom Brady . Al Michaels reads a message from Aaron Rodgers while on the call of Steelers-Broncos for Prime Video. https://t.co/R9HMP37Zam — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 27, 2026 Naturally, Herbstreit segued into comparing McCarthy and Rodgers to his divorced parents. Kirk Herbstreit compares Aaron Rodgers & Mike McCarthy to his divorced parents during the Steelers’ blowout win over the Broncos on Prime Video https://t.co/byKO07VOcT — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 28, 2026 “I don’t know if anybody ever has experienced what Aaron and Mike dealt with,” Herbstreit said. “They remind me — my family, I was eight years old when my mom and dad divorced. And my mom and dad, at some point, thought about getting back together when I was in my early teens. Eventually, they were not able to do that.” “It just almost reminds me of a couple that divorced in Green Bay, went their separate ways, and then decided to get back — for, let’s say, the kids’ sake — here in Pittsburgh,” Herbstreit continued. “They tried, they tried, they tried. And it just didn’t work out. But it wasn’t a team thing. It was an Aaron and Mike McCarthy thing, from

item.title: Kings erase early two-goal deficit, rally past Ducks 5-3
item.description: Adrian Kempe #9 of the Los Angeles Kings celebrates after scoring a goal during an NHL regular season game against the Anaheim Ducks on November 27, 2026 at Honda Center in Anaheim, California. ANAHEIM, Calif. — Returning to Southern California after a successful road trip, the Los Angeles Kings looked to build momentum against their crosstown rivals, who entered fresh off a dominant 7-0 shutout win on Wednesday over the San Jose Sharks. On Black Friday, Los Angeles delivered a statement victory, rallying from a two-goal deficit to defeat the Anaheim Ducks 5-3 on Friday afternoon at Honda Center. "I think every guy in here thinks we are a very dangerous team," forward Andre Lee said postgame. Although Cutter Gauthier has commanded much of the spotlight after tearing through November with 19 goals, it was 20-year-old defenseman Stian Solberg who stole the show, scoring his first two NHL goals to give Anaheim a 2-0 lead heading into the first intermission. The 2024 first-round pick from Norway was called up from the AHL's San Diego Gulls earlier this month and made his NHL debut against the Colorado Avalanche on Nov. 19. Solberg opened the scoring while working against fellow Norwegian Mats Zuccarello, outmaneuvering the veteran and snapping a close-range shot past Kings goaltender Darcy Kuemper into the top shelf. Stian Solberg #50 of the Anaheim Ducks celebrates his first NHL goal during an NHL regular season game against the Los Angeles Kings on November 27, 2026 at Honda Center in Anaheim, California. Steven Park - The Sporting Tribune Stian Solberg #50 of the Anaheim Ducks celebrates his first NHL goal during an NHL regular season game against the Los Angeles Kings on November 27, 2026 at Honda Center in Anaheim, California. He needed just 76 seconds to double his career total, firing a wrist shot from the point through traffic that slipped past Kuemper to double the Ducks' cushion. Zuccarello, who trained with Solberg during the offseason, had an answer for the rookie's fast start. Just over a minute into the middle frame, Zuccarello drove toward the slot and flung a shot toward Ducks goaltender Laurent Brossoit, who appeared caught off guard as the puck slid past his pads to cut Anaheim's lead in half. Norway that went in 🤯 https://t.co/ljD2CeWlGj — LA Kings (@LAKings) November 27, 2026 Later in the frame, Zuccarello matched his countryman with his second goal of the afternoon, taking a feed from Kevin Fiala on the near side before beating Brossoit again to tie the game at 2. The tally marked Zuccarello's first multi-goal performance since Jan. 22, when the 39-year-old forward was a member of the Minnesota Wild. "Really good team effort all throughout the lineup," Zuccarello said. "It was a big win for us." After coming up empty on a breakaway, Los Angeles seized its first lead when Joel Edmundson's point shot kicked out to Adrian Kempe, who buried the rebound for his seventh goal of the season to put the Kings ahead 3-2 with 11:11 remaining

item.title: Falcons Draft 2027: Way-Too-Early NFL Mock Draft 3.0
item.description: OXFORD, MISSISSIPPI - NOVEMBER 21: Trinidad Chambliss #6 of the Mississippi Rebels looks to pass during the game against the Wofford Terriers at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Oxford, Mississippi. (Photo by Justin Ford/Getty Images) | Getty Images Happy Thanksgiving, Falcons fans and welcome to the third iteration of what may become a weekly occurrence for the Atlanta Falcons, now that they’re at the bottom of the NFC South. The Panthers, mercifully, have gained a two-game lead over everyone else in the division. With teams like the Minnesota Vikings, Detroit Lions, and even the Cleveland Browns coming up, it’ll take some real adjustments to get the Falcons back to the top. So, without further ado, here’s another Way-Too-Early, yet somehow right-on-time, 2027 NFL mock draft for the Falcons. Hopefully, you find a pick in here to be thankful for! Falcons 2027 NFL Draft Picks Round 1, Pick 10 Round 2, Pick 41 Round 2, Pick 58 (Jessie Bates Trade) Round 3, Pick 72 Round 4, Pick 108 Round 6, Pick 218 (Compensatory Pick – David Onyemata) Round 6, Pick 223 (Compensatory Pick – Tyler Allgeier) Round 7, Pick 229 Round 1, Pick 10: Ashton Hampton Height: 6’2” Weight: 205 Ashton Hampton, CB Clemson 🐅 Listed at 6’2 200 • Sound tackler • Extremely competitive player • Physical in both the run and pass game • Good speed and length • Competes in run support • Reroutes receivers at the LOS • 31.8 Passer Rating when Targeted Hampton has all… pic.twitter.com/eOp3QsVdkV — peyton (@pdubyaa) October 6, 2026 The secondary for the Falcons has been one of the main points of contention this season, as teams have been able to bully the outside cornerbacks pretty consistently. Ashton Hampton would immediately bring physicality to the outside and has a mix of speed and agility that would allow him to keep up with smaller receivers as well. Round 2, Pick 41: Trinidad Chambliss, QB, Ole Miss Height: 6’0” Weight: 205 Trinidad Chambliss so far today: 16 of 22, 174 yards, 2 TDs, 1 rushing TD Steps up, rolls shoulder vs. pressure, hits his man over the MOF in-stride for RAC. I know he’s an outlier in multiple ways, but the NFL intangibles are there. I’ll bet on it. pic.twitter.com/sMWyU5mcf0 — Ian Cummings (@IC_Draft) October 10, 2026 In today’s day and age, nobody likes to spend a Day 2 pick on a quarterback because the thinking is, “If you believe he’s the guy, you should have just picked him in the first round.” However, with a guy like Trinidad Chambliss, who seems to have the athletic traits and composure to be a first-round pick but just doesn’t have the size to hold up at the next level, a Day 2 bet on him feels right. There’s no telling how good Chambliss could be or whether the opportunity cost of drafting him would be worth it, but if he pans out, that’ll make life for the Falcons over the next few years a whole lot easier. item.title: Back-end starter continues to build on underrated San Diego tenure
item.description: SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA - SEPTEMBER 27: Randy Vasquez #98 of the San Diego Padres pitches against the Arizona Diamondbacks during the first inning at Petco Park on September 27, 2026 in San Diego, California. (Photo by Orlando Ramirez/Getty Images) | Getty Images Welcome to our series grading every member of the San Diego Padres’ 40-man roster. The roster being evaluated is current as of Oct. 18, prior to the end of the World Series. Because of that, it will include players who will be free agents once the postseason concludes. Each player will be graded on their performance in the 2026 season, including the playoffs. That performance will be weighted based on how much time the player spent with the team (availability is the best ability). Randy Vásquez Vásquez was an under-the-radar piece in the blockbuster trade between the Padres and the New York Yankees for superstar Juan Soto. Soto and Trent Grisham were sent to the Bronx, with Michael King being the headliner of the return. At the time, Vásquez had pitched quite well in the big leagues, with a 2.87 ERA in 37 2/3 innings. He blossomed into a back-end rotation piece in San Diego, breaking out in 2025 with a 3.84 ERA over 133 2/3 innings of work. Overall Grade: C+ He started off 2026 even better. Vásquez pitched to a 1.88 ERA through his first five starts and a 2.96 ERA through his first 10 outings. He regressed in June (7.84 ERA, 20.2 IP) before turning in a phenomenal August and September (2.76 ERA, 45.2 IP). Vásquez ended the season with career highs in innings pitched (140.2) and strikeouts (87) along with a career-low 1.27 WHIP. Overall, Vásquez had an incredible 2026 campaign. He built on his breakout in 2025 and pushed himself to become a better pitcher. His underlying metrics in 2025 suggested that most of his success was luck. 2026 proved that it wasn’t all coincidence. The underlying stats still aren’t kind to Vásquez (5.54 xERA, .288 xBA), but he’s managed to prove those stats wrong. There is always a question of whether that success will continue. However, with Vásquez as the only viable starter on the Padres’ current rotation, San Diego seems to trust the right-hander to fill out the back end of their rotation in 2027 and beyond.

item.title: Sony’s 1000XM4C headphones are a Black Friday bargain at $198
item.description: The fan-favorite folding design returns with the comfortable, slightly improved XM4C headphones. | Photo: John Higgins / The Verge Instead of purely looking forward with its headphone designs, Sony went back to its popular WH-1000XM4 design and made some improvements to make it even better. The 2026 version, called the WH-1000XM4C, sounds nearly as good as the pricier XM6 model (currently $348), but is down to $198 during Black Friday at Amazon , Best Buy , and Walmart . That’s $100 off their October launch price. Sony WH-1000XM4C Where to Buy: $299.99 $198 at Amazon $299.99 $198 at Walmart $299.99 $199.99 at Best Buy There’s a reason why Sony went back to refine the XM4. Our former reviewer Chris Welch praised them for being super comfortable and for having close to perfect features for the price, especially compared to its successor, the XM3 (still my daily driver, for what it’s worth). The XM4s had better sound quality and noise cancellation, plus improved mics, multipoint connectivity, and a sensor that can detect when you remove them to automatically pause audio. Now, with the XM4C, there are further improvements, most notably a 10-band equalizer in the app (compared to the original XM4’s five-band) that my colleague John Higgins says really helped the headphones’ midrange frequencies open up. These are a great buy, but they aren’t your only Sony headphones deal to consider right now. Sony’s WH-1000XM5 are available during Black Friday at Best Buy for $169, their lowest price yet from a major retailer. There are upsides and downsides to this model: They feature improved noise cancellation thanks to more mics, despite using the same ANC chip as the XM4C, but they can’t fold up as compactly, making them a little bigger to pack in your bag. Either one you choose, you’ll have some great headphones to listen to going into 2027. Read our Sony WH-1000XM4C review .

item.title: Manhunt launched for killers of NSCDC officer in Benue
item.description: By Peter Duru, Makurdi The Chairman of Agatu Local Government Area of Benue State, Mr Melvin Ejeh, has vowed to ensure the arrest and prosecution of those responsible for the killing of an officer of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), Inspector Anyebe Anya. Anya was reportedly killed by armed men who attacked him at his duty post at a checkpoint in Agatu a few days ago. The assailants were also said to have carted away his service rifle after the attack. Ejeh gave the assurance when he visited the deceased officer’s family in Otukpo to commiserate with them, describing Anya as a hardworking, honest and dedicated officer. He vowed that those behind the killing would not escape justice, assuring the bereaved family that efforts were already underway to track down and apprehend the perpetrators. “Those that killed him will not go unpunished. We will get all of them. I knew him personally. He was a very hardworking, honest man who was committed to his work. “The whole community is mourning his death. The people of Agatu are shocked and grieving over his death. “We console his family. He was a committed officer. I can assure you that we will get those involved and they will be brought to justice. There is a hunt for them already. “The entire Agatu people will not rest until he gets justice, that I can assure his family,” the chairman said. Efforts to reach the Public Relations Officer of the Benue State NSCDC Command, SC Michael Ejelikwu, for comments were unsuccessful as of the time of filing this report. The post Manhunt launched for killers of NSCDC officer in Benue appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Meet Emmanuel Emegha, Chelsea’s new striking sensation who has Nigerian roots
item.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Chelsea’s latest attacking prospect, Emmanuel Emegha, is already giving supporters reasons to pay attention after scoring against Nottingham Forest on Friday. While the Blues trailed by two goals to nil, the 23-year-old striker, who joined Chelsea from French side Strasbourg, came off the bench to replace Danny Welbeck, found the net in the 54th and 89th minutes, and offered the Blues a lifeline in their Premier League encounter. However, his goals were not enough as Forest held unto their lead after Morgan Gibss-White had extended it immediately after, bringing the game to a 3-2 full-time result. Before the Forest clash, Emegha put Chelsea ahead at home when they hosted Leeds United last week. Unfortunately, he could not save the team from capitulating to a 1-4 defeat in the game. But beyond his growing reputation in England, Emegha has an interesting connection to Nigeria. Born in The Hague, Netherlands, to a Togolese father and a Nigerian mother, the powerful forward has West African roots. His Nigerian heritage makes him a player of interest to Nigerian football fans, particularly those following the growing number of players of Nigerian descent making waves in European football. However, Emegha has chosen to represent the Netherlands internationally. He made his senior debut against Poland in November 2025, explaining that the Netherlands is his country and that he is proud to be Dutch. Although Nigeria missed out on having him represent the Super Eagles, his progress at Chelsea gives Nigerian fans another reason to follow his career closely. At 23, Emegha has the physical presence, pace and goalscoring instincts to make an impression in English football. His latest goals against Nottingham Forest are another early signs of what he could offer Chelsea. The post Meet Emmanuel Emegha, Chelsea’s new striking sensation who has Nigerian roots appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: The new iPad Mini is getting its first major discount for Black Friday
item.description: I’m not saying you should read on an iPad next to fountain. I’m just saying you can. | Photo: David Pierce / The Verge We were big fans of Apple’s new iPad Mini when we reviewed it in early November, but its steep starting price of $699 was hard to swallow. Thankfully, the small tablet is already getting a sizable discount for Black Friday. Right now, Amazon and Walmart are both selling the 2026 iPad Mini with Wi-Fi and 128GB of storage starting at $599 ($100 off), its lowest price to date. iPad Mini (2026) Where to Buy: $699 $599 at Amazon (Wi-Fi, 128GB) $699 $599 at Walmart (Wi-Fi, 128GB) $799 $749 at Amazon (Wi-Fi, 256GB) The new Mini is a notable upgrade over its predecessor, with a larger 8.5-inch OLED display that delivers deeper blacks and better contrast than the previous model’s 8.3-inch LCD. Despite the bigger screen, the tablet itself is smaller and lighter, making it easier to carry. Apple also added IP67 dust and water resistance, so you have less reason to worry about where you use it. As my colleague David Pierce noted in his review, that made a big difference in his day-to-day use; he felt more comfortable handing the Mini to his spill-prone toddler or keeping it nearby in the kitchen to follow recipes. He even took it into the shower to keep watching a football game. The upgraded A20 Pro chip also made apps load faster and demanding games run better in Pierce’s testing, while battery life held steady at around nine hours of screentime. At $599, though, the new Mini is still relatively expensive if you mainly want a tablet for browsing the web or streaming shows. The last-gen iPad Mini, which runs on Apple’s A17 Pro chip, is available for under $500 if you’d rather save another $100 and can live without the OLED screen and water resistance. But if you’ve been waiting for a more worthwhile upgrade to Apple’s smallest tablet, the current Black Friday discount makes the new model easier to justify. iPad Mini (2024) Where to Buy: $599 $484 at Amazon (128GB, Wi-Fi) $699 $584 at Amazon (256GB, Wi-Fi) $899 $784 at Amazon (512GB, Wi-Fi) Read our full iPad Mini review .

item.title: Chelsea beaten at Nottingham Forest as poor run continues
item.description: Nottingham Forest claimed a memorable 3-2 victory over Chelsea at the City Ground on Friday night, November 27, piling further pressure on Blues manager Xabi Alonso after another disappointing performance from his side. Forest made a flying start to the encounter, taking the lead just five minutes into the game through Igor Jesus, who produced a superb volley from Daniel Muñoz’s cross to put the hosts ahead. Chelsea struggled to find their rhythm in the opening half, with Forest looking more dangerous and organised in attack. Despite enjoying more possession, the visitors failed to turn their dominance on the ball into meaningful goalscoring opportunities. The hosts doubled their advantage shortly after the restart when Morgan Gibbs-White converted from the penalty spot in the 51st minute. The penalty was awarded after Wesley Fofana brought down Liam Delap inside the Chelsea box. However, Chelsea responded three minutes later through substitute Emmanuel Emegha, who pulled one back after Pedro Neto’s effort took a deflection and fell kindly into his path. The goal briefly offered Chelsea hope of mounting a comeback, but Forest remained dangerous and restored their two-goal cushion in the 72nd minute when Gibbs-White grabbed his second of the evening. Chelsea refused to surrender, with Emegha scoring again in the 89th minute to reduce the deficit to 3-2 and set up a tense finish. However, Forest held on through the closing moments to secure all three points and condemn Chelsea to another painful defeat. The result represents another setback for Alonso, whose team have struggled for consistency in recent weeks. Chelsea’s defensive weaknesses and inability to control crucial moments once again proved costly. For Nottingham Forest, the victory provides a significant boost and a valuable reward for their determination and attacking efficiency. Chelsea must now turn their attention to their next Premier League fixture against Crystal Palace as they look to recover from another frustrating night. The post Chelsea beaten at Nottingham Forest as poor run continues appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Nigeria’s $1bn Monthly Remittance Has Been Achieved – CBN Governor Cardoso
item.description: Nigeria has achieved its $1 billion monthly diaspora remittance target, the Central Bank of Nigeria has said. CBN Governor Olayemi Cardoso, who disclosed this at the 61st Annual Bankers’ Dinner of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (CIBN) in Lagos on Friday, said Nigeria now targets $1.5 billion in monthly remittances by the end of the first half of 2027. “The fact that you can go abroad, put in your card, and make payment, yes, that is great convenience for everybody, great convenience. But beyond all that, one thing we should never forget — three years ago, two years ago, you couldn’t do all these things. “And what used to happen, you go somewhere, you want to make payments, you either have to pay in cash or use a card, which gets thrown away, and you’re disrespected,” he said. “What this has done, it has brought back the respect of all Nigerians abroad. “When I stood before you last year. I spoke of our ambition to increase monthly remittances to $1 billion a month. I am pleased to report that this milestone has been achieved. “We are now working towards increasing monthly remittances to $1.5 billion by the end of the first half of 2027,” Cardoso added. He commended licensed International Money Transfer Operators (IMTOs) for their efforts to strengthen transparency, invest in technology, and expand formal remittance channels, particularly across Asia. ﻿ Cardoso said that the next phase of Nigeria’s financial reforms must focus on deepening liquidity, broadening participation, and expanding the range of financial instruments available to businesses and investors. “The naira has strengthened by approximately six per cent over the past year, while daily foreign exchange market turnover has at times exceeded $1 billion. “In the fixed income market, daily turnover averages N1.5 trillion, supported by a credible tradable benchmark yield curve extending to 10 years. “What, what does all this mean? It is an encouraging sign of growing market confidence. The market deepens; more activity takes place when there’s confidence in the market,” he said. According to him, the priority is to ensure that markets continue to support efficient price discovery and capital allocation. “As recent movements in the foreign exchange market remind us, a well-functioning market does not mean that prices remain static. It does not mean that prices remain static. “They go up, they come down. Volatility is an inherent feature of global financial markets, and a market-determined exchange rate must be allowed to move in both directions in response to macroeconomic fundamentals and global development. “Emerging market currencies, including ours, have experienced volatility amidst changes in the United States’ interest rate environment and global risk sentiment. “Nigeria, as I have said, is part of this interconnected global financial system, but believe me, we are considerably better equipped to manage external shocks than we were three years ago.” According to him,

item.title: A Weekend For Proof
item.description: INEC tests its systems on Saturday. Opposition leaders face their own test on Monday. Campaign violence makes both exercises more consequential. By Tuesday, Nigerians should have fresh evidence about two institutions seeking their confidence. INEC will have conducted its nationwide mock accreditation and result-upload exercise. Opposition parties will have had their scheduled opportunity to formalise cooperation in Abuja. The first must demonstrate operational readiness. The second must demonstrate an ability to act together. Both approach those tests amid a worsening concern: whether citizens can participate in the campaign safely. Wednesday’s attack on Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) supporters in Benin City, Edo State, confirmed by the police, followed Monday’s deadly violence in Delta. Edo police reported one person injured and ordered an investigation. The attackers’ political affiliations and any sponsors have not been established. That development changes the context of the coming days. Electoral preparation now requires visible progress on protection, accountability and public confidence alongside equipment and political agreements. Saturday: Let The Test Produce Evidence INEC’s mock exercise is scheduled for November 28, from 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Nigerian time, in 17,676 selected polling units. It will test accreditation, election devices, and the uploading and viewing of simulated results. Registered voters in the selected units are expected to participate. The most useful outcome would be a public account of performance. How many locations opened on time? How many participants were successfully accredited? Where did devices fail? How long did uploads take? How were exceptions resolved? A rehearsal can reveal problems that announcements cannot. Finding a fault early allows INEC to correct it. Explaining that correction gives citizens a reason to have greater confidence. The exercise also has practical support from state governments. Lagos has cancelled Saturday’s sanitation exercise, while Anambra has postponed its own, to avoid obstructing participation. Those decisions remove an immediate obstacle. The remaining test concerns delivery at the selected polling units. Monday: What Will Opposition Unity Require? Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, Seyi Makinde and other opposition leaders are expected at the November 30 summit. Their attendance and any signed commitments remain forthcoming. The APC says it is untroubled by the proposed gathering. The parties’ task is to define cooperation precisely. Joint election monitoring could be valuable. So could common procedures for documenting intimidation, sharing verified information and coordinating legal responses. Presidential cooperation presents more difficult choices. Supporters need to know whether their parties intend to campaign separately, endorse an existing candidate or pursue another lawful arrangement. A declaration of unity leaves those questions open unless it specifies obligations.

item.title: Ogun 2027: Court dismisses Hunye’s suits against Adeola’s APC candidacy
item.description: …Adeola hails judgment …as Hunye heads to Court of Appeal By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta The Federal High Court sitting in Abeokuta, Ogun State, on Friday dismissed two suits filed by Hon. Abayomi Semako Hunye challenging the emergence of Senator Solomon Olamilekan Adeola, popularly known as Yayi, as the All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidate for the 2027 election. Delivering judgment in the two consolidated suits, Justice Okeke held that the cases lacked merit and consequently dismissed them. The suits, marked FHC/ABJ/CS/1127/2026 and FHC/AB/126/2026, were instituted by Hunye against the APC, Senator Adeola and the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), challenging the process through which Adeola emerged as the party’s governorship candidate. Reacting to the judgment, Adeola commended the judiciary, describing the decision as a vindication of the rule of law and the judicial process. In a statement issued by his media adviser, Chief Kayode Odunaro, the senator expressed satisfaction with the outcome while appreciating his legal team for what he described as their painstaking efforts in defending the suits. Adeola said, “I want to commend the Honourable Justice for his erudite judgment in these cases challenging my overwhelming and widely accepted victory in our party primary. I also commend my legal team for the painstaking defense put up during the process. “This victory is yet another milestone in our quest for equity and justice in the Ogun State 2027 election. To God be the glory once again.” The senator said that despite the legal challenges, he had remained focused on consolidating support for his candidacy across the state through engagements with political stakeholders and other interest groups. He added that his engagements had also included the presentation of his nine-pillar ITESIWAJU Agenda, which he described as his development blueprint for Ogun State. According to him, the court’s decision would allow him to concentrate more fully on preparations for the 2027 governorship election and take his campaign message to voters across the state. Adeola also urged APC members and his supporters, irrespective of their political affiliations, to remain united and focused, stressing that his ambition was driven by a desire to serve the people and contribute to the development of Ogun State. However, Hunye has rejected the outcome of the proceedings and indicated his intention to appeal the judgment. In a statement titled, “Our Legal Journey Continues to the Court of Appeal,” Hunye described the Federal High Court as the first stage of the judicial process, insisting that the appellate court would provide another opportunity for his legal team to pursue the issues raised in the suits. He reaffirmed his commitment to constitutional due process, internal party democracy, and the rule of law, saying his decision to continue with the litigation was informed by the need to ensure fairness and strict compliance with establi

item.title: Two Nigerians arrested over romance scam in Thailand
item.description: Two Nigerian men have been arrested in Thailand over their alleged links to an international romance scam network targeting victims across Southeast Asia. The suspects, aged 41 and 30, were arrested on November 18 at a condominium in Ban Mai, Pak Kret district, Nonthaburi, following an investigation by Thailand’s Immigration Division 3 and Provincial Police Region 1. According to local media outlet, The Thaiger, undercover police officers disguised themselves as food delivery workers to gain access to the suspects’ apartment. With the help of security guards, the officers approached the condominium and pretended to have a parcel for delivery. When one of the men opened the door, they identified themselves as police officers and moved in to arrest both suspects. A search of the apartment reportedly led to the recovery of laptops and mobile phones containing messages linked to fake online identities posing as US military personnel. Investigators suspect the identities were used to establish romantic relationships with potential victims as part of an international scam operation. Police also reportedly found social media accounts allegedly created to deceive Thai residents. The arrests followed an earlier investigation on November 12, when police detained another Nigerian man, aged 37, at Owl Market in Nonthaburi over suspected links to the same network. Investigators later searched a condominium in Bang Kraso, Mueang Nonthaburi, where suspected members of the group had reportedly stayed. However, the men had left before the search. Police subsequently traced the two suspects to another condominium in the Muang Thong Thani area, where they were believed to have stayed for two to three days before their arrest. The Thaiger reported that both men confessed during questioning. However, the charges publicly reported against them are immigration-related offences, including illegal entry and unauthorised residence. One of the suspects, aged 41, had reportedly overstayed his permitted stay in Thailand by 411 days. Authorities revoked their permission to remain in the country and transferred them to Pak Kret Police Station for further legal proceedings ahead of deportation. The investigation into the suspected romance scam network is ongoing. Thai police have not disclosed the identities of the alleged victims, the amount of money involved or the specific roles the two men allegedly played in the operation. The reported immigration charges do not amount to convictions for romance fraud. The post Two Nigerians arrested over romance scam in Thailand appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Adesua Etomi celebrates negative cancer test
item.description: Nollywood actress Adesua Etomi-Wellington has celebrated testing negative for cancer after months of medical procedures, hospital visits and uncertainty over her health. The actress announced the development on Friday in an Instagram video, expressing gratitude to God following the latest result from her medical tests. “The doctor just called me back with the result from the lab, no cancer… God is good,” she said. The video showed some of the medical procedures she underwent, while other pictures revealed bruises on her body and redness beneath one of her eyes. Etomi-Wellington also shared a video of friends and well-wishers celebrating the result with her. Reflecting on her experience, the actress described 2026 as one of the most difficult periods of her life, explaining that her reduced public appearances were linked to her health struggles. “2026 really tried it. I know I’ve been quieter than usual this year (and that’s saying something), but behind the silence were some of the most difficult months of my life,” she wrote. She disclosed that the ordeal involved several medical procedures, scans, injections and hospital visits, adding that she received treatment from medical teams in Nigeria and the United States. “This year threw everything at me, but by the grace of God, I am NOT EASILY BROKEN,” she added. The actress also expressed appreciation to her husband, singer and politician Bankole Wellington, popularly known as Banky W, their children, friends and family members for supporting her throughout the difficult period. “To my friends and family who prayed for me, stood in the gap and held me through some of my darkest days, I will never take your love for granted,” she wrote. The health update comes two days after the couple released a gospel song, On My Way , on November 25 to celebrate their ninth wedding anniversary. The track, credited to Etomi-Wellington, who performs under the musical name Susu, and Banky W, is the lead single from their forthcoming joint album, Not Easily Broken , expected in 2027. The actress described the song as “the soundtrack to our testimony and thanksgiving”, linking its message to their personal experiences. The couple have previously spoken about their health challenges. In May 2024, Banky W disclosed that he had undergone his fourth surgery for cancer after earlier procedures to remove cancerous tumours. Etomi-Wellington also revealed in March 2025 that she battled hyperemesis gravidarum, a severe form of pregnancy sickness, during her second pregnancy. The condition left her ill for months and required hospitalisation before she underwent an emergency Caesarean section. The post Adesua Etomi celebrates negative cancer test appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: UK lists two conditions for bringing goods into country without paying tax
item.description: The United Kingdom government has outlined two conditions under which travellers can bring goods into the country without paying customs duty or tax, warning that items outside the permitted categories or allowance limits could attract charges. According to the UK government’s customs guidelines, travellers can bring goods into the country tax-free under two conditions. First condition is personal use. Goods must be intended for the traveller’s own use rather than for commercial purposes or resale. Second condition is gifts. Travellers can also bring goods intended as presents for other people without paying customs duty, provided they remain within the applicable personal allowance. The rules apply to foreign visitors and British residents returning from overseas, regardless of whether the items were purchased from regular shops or duty-free outlets at airports. However, the exemptions are subject to personal allowance limits, which determine the quantity and value of goods travellers can bring into the country without incurring additional charges. The applicable allowance depends on where a traveller is arriving from and whether the destination is Great Britain, comprising England, Scotland and Wales, or Northern Ireland. The government also warned that goods intended for business or resale do not qualify for personal allowances. Such items must be declared to customs regardless of their value or quantity. Travellers are also required to declare goods that exceed their personal allowances or fall under banned and restricted categories before crossing the border. Declarations can be made online up to five days, or 120 hours, before arrival in the UK. The authorities warned that failure to comply with customs regulations could result in the seizure of goods and, in some cases, the vehicle used to transport them. Offenders may also face financial penalties or prosecution. The post UK lists two conditions for bringing goods into country without paying tax appeared first on Vanguard News .
